"PREMIER PLAY" has had no $3 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

How far "PREMIER PLAY" is through its run does not decide anything by itself. It changes how closely to look at the other numbers.

If "PREMIER PLAY" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2414.headline: No top prize claimed lately

2415.body:

Everything above about "Double The Money" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

2422.headline: What the prize table shows

2426.body:
"HAUNTED HUNDREDS" is near the midpoint of its run, with about half of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

If you play "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
